desc: Add packed single-precision floating-point values in a and b.
Performs a SIMD addition of eight packed single-precision floating-point elements in m1 and m2.
Each warp thread reads a 32-bit value from the lane given by srcLane.
Each warp thread reads a 32-bit value from the lane at srcLane minus delta.
Each warp thread reads a 32-bit value from the lane at srcLane plus delta.
Each warp thread reads a 32-bit value from the lane srcLane XOR mask.
Add corresponding elements of two vectors.
prim: ptx:shfl.sync.b32 d[|p], a, b, c, membermask
